purpose: Real acceptance fixture control. Keep actual Base identifiers and test-account values only in a local, non-distributed copy.

confirmed_missing.initial_state: A recorded interview has a required material component absent.
confirmed_missing.expected_effect: Stop follow-up, retain a visible limitation, allow CEO informed review, and do not mark the material complete.

reset_assertions.four_writable_fields: Read back exact initial values for every selected record.
reset_assertions.attachments: Read back the expected missing, invalid, duplicate, and confirmed-missing fixture attachments.
